row.title: SILENT-FAIL-1: silent-failure classes are data with detectors
row.body: Classes live in doctrine/silent-failures.json, each bound to a detector. Worker bundle, duplicate-module and live-citation checks run in checks. An incident matching no class is a finding. A Status: done claim cites a server-side Live: GET line.
